name: Karwendel Camping
beschreibung: Karwendel Camping in Maurach am Achensee is located in the Tiroler Unterland. The site offers a quiet, close-to-nature atmosphere. The surroundings are characterized by the Karwendelbergen, forests and the Achensee. In the region there are hiking trails and ski areas. The facilities include pitches for motorhomes and tents, sanitary facilities and a sales kiosk. Guests can expect simple, practical overnight accommodation in nature. The campsite is open seasonally.
